public.title: Backspace String Compare
public.description: Compare two editor histories containing lowercase English letters and #. A # deletes the immediately preceding surviving character, or does nothing when empty. Return whether both final strings match. Histories have length 0 to 10000.
hints: Deleting from an empty stack leaves it empty.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Apply editor operations using a character stack and compare the final text. O(m+n) time and space.
